name: @domainspec-v2/cli
description: DomainSpec v2 compiler, generator, verifier, and certifier.

scripts.typecheck: npm run catalog:check && npm run relationships:check && npm run integration-profile:check && tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit --pretty false
scripts.build: npm run catalog:check && npm run relationships:check && npm run integration-profile:check && tsc -p tsconfig.json
scripts.test: npm run test:proof && npm run test:parallel
scripts.test:parallel: node --import tsx --test test/cli/main.test.ts test/conformance/observe-target.test.ts test/generation/exact-uint64.test.ts test/generation/declarative-function.test.ts test/generation/portable-function.test.ts test/generation/guarded-bindings.test.ts test/generation/project-composition.test.ts test/generation/plan-instantiation.test.ts test/generation/publish-instantiation.test.ts test/governance-kernel/governance-kernel.test.mjs test/input/operation-relationships.test.ts test/input/project-model.test.ts test/input/project-root.test.ts test/l1-project.test.ts test/meta-types/catalog.test.ts test/query-vertical.test.ts test/recipe/deployment-recipe.test.ts test/qualification/recipe-qualification.test.ts test/release/release-candidate.test.mjs test/rule-vertical.test.ts test/runtime-l2.test.ts test/runtime-l3-postgres.test.ts test/static-backend-completion.test.ts test/system-integration/profile.test.ts test/thin-backend-verticals.test.ts test/typed-operation/contracts.test.ts test/typed-operation/hardening.test.ts test/typed-operation/rust.test.ts
scripts.verify:product: npm run typecheck && npm run system-integration:check && npm run test && npm run test:contract && npm run build && npm run validate:rust && npm run validate:clean-package
